test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: The total surface area of a cylinder is 4092 cm² and the diameter of its base is 21 cm. What is 50% volume (in cm³) of the cylinder (nearest to an integer)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h) ⇒ 4092 = 2 × 22/7 × 10.5 × (10.5 + h)

4092 = 66 × (10.5 + h) ⇒ 62 = 10.5 + h ⇒ h = 51.5 cm

50% Volume = 1/2 × πr²h = 1/2 × 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5 × 51.5

50% Volume = 11 × 1.5 × 10.5 × 51.5 = 173.25 × 51.5 = 8922.375 ≈ 8922 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 8922 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 4092 cm²

Diameter (d) = 21 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

TSA of Cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c050447bd69e092e9c4e05922cb6e17649df0e9392d89e0e574576486c9ddd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4092 = 2 × (22/7) × 10.5 × (10.5 + h)

⇒ 4092 = 44 × 1.5 × (10.5 + h)

⇒ 4092 = 66 × (10.5 + h)

⇒ 10.5 + h = 4092 ÷ 66

⇒ 10.5 + h = 62

⇒ h = 62 − 10.5 = 51.5 cm

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = πr²h = (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 51.5

⇒ Volume = 22 × 1.5 × 10.5 × 51.5

⇒ Volume = 33 × 10.5 × 51.5 = 17844.75 cm³

⇒ 50% Volume = 17844.75 ÷ 2 = 8922.375 cm³

⇒ Nearest integer = 8922 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 8922 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral or curved surface area of a cylinder is given by the formula 2πrh.

Hollow Cylinder

The volume of a hollow cylinder with external radius R and internal radius r is π(R² − r²)h.

Volume of Cone relationship

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder has 1/3 the volume of that cylinder: V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3)πr²h.</p
